```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
ParquetFileReader$create("data/daily_prices.parquet")$GetSchema()
```

```{r}
open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarise(avg_market_cap_usd = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap_usd)) |>
  collect()
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- read_parquet("data/daily_prices.parquet")
metadata <- read_parquet("data/coin_metadata.parquet")
categories <- read_parquet("data/categories.parquet")

crypto <- prices |>
  mutate(date = as.Date(date_raw)) |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |> rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  )
```

```{r}
metadata |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
metadata <- metadata |>
  mutate(launch_date_parsed = as.Date(
    lubridate::parse_date_time(launch_date, orders = c("ymd", "B d, Y"))
  ))

metadata |>
  arrange(launch_date_parsed) |>
  select(coin_id, coin_name, launch_date, launch_date_parsed) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date_raw, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Price (USD)")
```

```{r}
category_market_caps <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarise(market_cap_usd = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(category_name = fct_reorder(category_name, market_cap_usd, .fun = mean, .desc = TRUE))

shock_windows <- tibble(
  event = c("Luna / UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
  start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
  end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11"))
) |>
  mutate(midpoint = start + (end - start) / 2)

ggplot(category_market_caps, aes(x = date, y = market_cap_usd, fill = category_name)) +
  geom_area(position = "fill") +
  geom_rect(
    data = shock_windows,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey30",
    alpha = 0.16
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(shock_windows$start, shock_windows$end),
    color = "grey25",
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_label(
    data = shock_windows,
    aes(x = midpoint, y = 1, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = 1.2,
    size = 3,
    label.size = 0,
    fill = "white"
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", name = "Category") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  labs(
    title = "Crypto Market-Cap Composition Over Time",
    subtitle = "Each colored band shows a category's share of the total market capitalization on each day.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of total market capitalization",
    caption = "Source: Provided daily price, coin metadata, and category data."
  )
```
